ChatWebSocketMessage.description: Messages sent from client to server over WebSocket.

type.description: Message type: 'message' = chat message, 'cancel' = abort operation, 'answer' = respond to question

options.description: Additional options for the chat interaction (optional for 'message' type)

answer.description: Answer to a question (required for 'answer' type)

value.description: Answer value (string for input/select/password, boolean for confirm, string[] for checklist)

ChatWebSocketEvent.description: Events sent from server to client over WebSocket.

type.description: Event type: 'token' = streaming text, 'status' = status update, 'tool' = tool execution, 'question' = agent question, 'error' = error occurred, 'done' = response complete

data.description: Event payload (structure varies by event type)
